Full current numeric field API and scalar math workflow executes. Inherited Control semantic/editor/text capabilities and native pointer warp retain owner gates. Wayland relative dragging and restoration of the previous pointer mode execute; exact cursor reposition needs advertised MouseWarp/compositor protocol support. General object/string/collection Expression scripting is outside this scalar field projection under ADR 0001 and needs an accepted typed expression-host boundary.
ADR 0004: pinned SpinBox.xml declares updown and set_min_buttons_width_from_icons deprecated. Use up/down state icons and negative buttons_width instead; no aliases or obsolete theme keys shipped.

First complete color authoring consumer: Range/LineEdit/SpinBox, sliders, themes, PopupPanel/MenuButton/FileDialog and Color math now execute. Remaining connected prerequisites are ColorPalette resource/files, picker-shape and RGB/HSV/OKHSL/raw/linear controls, preset/palette workflow and actual rendered-viewport legacy sampler. Native external screen capture/color picker require DisplayServer capabilities; they do not block the supported application-window sampler.
